chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Bukayr ibn Aʿyan, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: “The one making a will has the right to revoke it, whether he is in good health or ill.”

key_terms.أَنْ يَرْجِعَ: to revoke, withdraw, or go back on it
key_terms.لِلْمُوصِي: the person making the will or bequest

ai.seo_question: Can a person revoke a will in Islam while healthy or during illness?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that a person who has made a will may revoke or alter it. That right remains valid whether the person is in a state of health or sickness, indicating the continuing authority of the testator over his وصية during his lifetime.
